title: Spec path shorthand ambiguity caused wrong-path write during run
description: The spec moeb-source-signal-github-routing uses `src/moeb/internal/` as a shorthand for the Rust source directory `src/moeb/src/internal/`. However, `src/moeb/internal/` also exists on disk as a harness assets directory. The ambiguity caused a file to be written to the wrong location during run 18eadcc3-b142-4096-b3ac-5cbde9dc570c, requiring a delete-and-rewrite correction and producing a write-review-compliance fail that had to be remediated separately.
proposed_resolution: Establish a spec authoring convention that either (a) mandates canonical disk paths in all file path references, or (b) documents the shorthand explicitly in the spec preamble (e.g., 'Note: src/moeb/internal/ in this spec refers to src/moeb/src/internal/ on disk'). Update the spec template to include this guidance.
